score_definition: Within each map, average measured and anchor widths separately across the matched qualified wall pairs for each diffraction order. Paired absolute-width error is the mean absolute difference between those two map-mean widths, averaged equally over orders. Group summaries give each map equal weight.

nominal_fixed_window.definition: Original-cohort sections with measured and all four relaxed model width pairs qualified in both orders.

all_three_windows.definition: Same eligibility rule intersected across 2.50, 4.25 and adaptive half-windows; used in Fig. 2b.

resampling.block_side_definition: factor × sqrt(2/sqrt(3)) × map median spacing_nm; triangular-cell-area approximation.
resampling.block_side_spacing_support: All original-cohort wall geometries per map, matching the released 243-wall score bootstrap; width values are resampled only on the qualified 239-pair cohort.
resampling.draw_rule: Sample the occupied spatial blocks with replacement, drawing the same number of blocks as occupied; include all wall pairs in each selected block.
resampling.pairing: Each resampled block jointly carries measured and anchor widths in both orders; maps are held fixed and averaged equally.
resampling.interval: P5–P95 percentile range (90% conditional within-map spatial block resampling range).
resampling.support_note: Map bars are omitted when any origin phase has fewer than two occupied blocks; dagger marks that limited support. One-block phases contribute no within-map spread to the group bootstrap.

group_contrast.low_minus_high_definition: Equal-map mean of per-map paired absolute-width errors in low four maps minus the equal-map mean in high six maps.

limits: Intervals describe conditional spatial sensitivity within these ten previously examined maps with fitted physics and optical responses fixed; maps are not resampled.
No independent device crosswalk is available, so these ranges are not device-level confidence intervals and do not include acquisition, detector, probe or model uncertainty.
At the primary block scale DS1 has one occupied block at all four origins; its group-bootstrap contribution is fixed, and its spatial range cannot be estimated.
